title: Bronze Rewards Card: Redeeming Your Rewards and Cash Back Options
summary: This document explains how to redeem Bronze Rewards Card earnings, including the $17 minimum threshold, redemption options (statement credit, on-demand redemption, and auto-redeem), and the step-by-step online process. Rewards accrue at 1.0% on eligible purchases, and redeemable balances reflect accrued rewards minus reversals for returns.
